title: Electrical and Electronic Equipment Assemblers
description: Assemble or modify electrical or electronic equipment, such as computers, test equipment telemetering systems, electric motors, and batteries.

tasks.text: Inspect or test wiring installations, assemblies, or circuits for resistance factors or for operation, and record results.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Assemble electrical or electronic systems or support structures and install components, units, subassemblies, wiring, or assembly casings, using rivets, bolts, soldering or micro-welding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering requires fine manual dexterity

tasks.text: Explain assembly procedures or techniques to other workers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Equipment instruction requires live demonstration and correction

dwas.name: Instruct workers to use equipment or perform technical procedures.

tasks.text: Confer with supervisors or engineers to plan or review work activities or to resolve production problems.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Colleague information exchange is relational, contextual

dwas.name: Exchange information with colleagues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

dwas.name: Confer with others to resolve production problems or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Pack finished assemblies for shipment, and transport them to storage areas, using hoists or handtrucks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.
Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Clean parts, using cleaning solutions, air hoses, and cloths.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of physical workpieces

tasks.text: Read and interpret schematic drawings, diagrams, blueprints, specifications, work orders, or reports to determine materials requirements or assembly instructions.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Distribute materials, supplies, or subassemblies to work areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically delivering supplies to workers

tasks.text: Fabricate or form parts, coils, or structures according to specifications, using drills, calipers, cutters, or saws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fine dexterity assembling electronics

tasks.text: Mark and tag components so that stock inventory can be tracked and identified.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Position, align, or adjust workpieces or electrical parts to facilitate wiring or assembly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Adjust, repair, or replace electrical or electronic components to correct defects and to ensure conformance to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disassembly and reassembly of parts

tasks.text: Complete, review, or maintain production, time, or component waste reports.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Measure and adjust voltages to specified values to determine operational accuracy of instruments.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.
Adjust flow of electricity to tools or production equipment.

tasks.text: Drill or tap holes in specified equipment locations to mount control units or to provide openings for elements, wiring, or instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Paint structures as specified, using paint sprayers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual spray/coating control requires dexterity and judgment

tasks.text: Instruct customers in the installation, repair, or maintenance of products.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Advice good; hands-on equipment context needs human

dwas.name: Advise others on issues related to repairs, installation, or equipment design.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others
